# Chapter 6 — 你怎么不吃了 (Why Don’t You Eat More?)

**Pinyin:** Nǐ zěnme bù chī le  
**Source:** *HSK Standard Course 2*, printed pages 41–48 (source image pages 061–068).

## Unique Hanzi in New Words

Distinct characters in the New Words entries, listed once in order of first appearance: **门、外、自、行、车、羊、肉、好、吃、面、条、打、篮、球、因、为、所、以、游、泳、经、常、公、斤、姐** (25 characters).

The warm-up on p. 41 also prompts **喝牛奶、起床、跑步、看报纸、吃药、打篮球** and asks learners to identify **自行车、足球、篮球、面条** in pictures; these are activity prompts, not additional numbered New Words entries.

## Characters

The Characters section on printed pp. 46–47 covers single-component characters and radicals separately from the New Words list:

- **Single-component characters (pp. 46–47):** **门** (mén, door) and **羊** (yáng, sheep).
- **Radicals (p. 47):** **犭** (反犬旁, usually associated with animals; examples **猫** māo, cat, and **狗** gǒu, dog) and **心** (心字底, generally associated with thought and emotion; examples **想** xiǎng, to think/want, and **念** niàn, to miss/think of).
